title: single-use authorization code
means: Each code can be exchanged once before it expires. The pinned token error response classes an invalid authorization code as invalid_grant (401).

title: invalid PKCE verifier
means: OAuth.TokenError401: Invalid code_verifier for PKCE flow returns invalid_grant.

title: mismatched redirect URI
means: OAuth.TokenError400: Invalid redirect_uri (does not match authorization request) is a bad request.
